title.narrative: Land and Corruption in Africa Phase II (LCAII)

description.narrative: Through this project: • women, men and youth in Africa will be better equipped and mobilized to demand transparency and accountability in the land sector (Outcome 1); • a diverse and inclusive set of stakeholders from civil society to private sector will advance anti-corruption initiatives to promote fair and transparent land governance (Outcome 2); • national and local decision-makers will adopt anti-corruption laws, policies and measures to prevent and redress corruption in land distribution, acquisition, dispute management and sanctions infractions (Outcome 3). Value of the contract is EUR 3,500,000.

participating-org.narrative: Germany - Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development

recipient-region.narrative: The countries involved are Cameroon, Ghana, Kenya, Madagascar, South Africa, Uganda, Zambia, and Zimbabwe.
